decisions.decision:
T-251 is done, so build on current main, not tantra-walkthroughs. Re-find each finding in the post-e4bd0b8 code; AUDIT.md line numbers are stale.

1. jobs.ts (X031, X037): add a one-click Cloudflare zone move (POST /zones, then show the nameserver swap). Write Resend and DMARC records only once the zone is active. Also offer to pick a report domain already in the account.
2. jobs-day2.ts (X036): if no workers.dev subdomain exists, create one with PUT /accounts/{id}/workers/subdomain.
3. agentic.ts (X039): make the start-cf-registrar gate run the stack.ts registrar domain-check, and fail it when billing or registrar access is missing.
4. workshop-cards.ts (X025, N091, N027): default to Sign in with Google proof, add a TXT how-to for DNS hosted elsewhere, and have the agent register the calendar domain through Cloudflare Registrar.

Run write paths only in the simulator. Prove both done-when checks with probes, then mark all 7 ids fixed in AUDIT.md with the commit.
decisions.why: T-251 has landed, which clears the merge-order block. Every step is code on our own systems. The vendor-accounts-no-change-rule says write paths run in the simulator only. orchestrator-autonomy and build-fully-a[redacted] say finish without asking.
